name: Grizzly Lake
why: Over a ridge of tundra and boulders to a lake under the black granite spires of the Tombstone Range, in the Yukon's 'Patagonia of the North'.
book: Backcountry campsite reservation on the Yukon government site (Grizzly Lake can be the first night). The trailhead is at km 58.5 of the Dempster Highway, 1.5 h from Dawson City.
water: Streams and the lake; treat it.
dangers: Grizzly bears: bear spray and the food lockers at camp.
Snow and wind on the ridge in any month.
Rough boulder fields where the trail is hard to see in fog.
